name: Ears & balance

overlay.caption: spinning sets the inner-ear fluid swirling · it keeps going after you stop

does: Shows dizziness growing with the number of spins
Shows it fading by itself in the seconds after stopping
Shows the eyes flicking while the inner-ear fluid is still moving
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Include motion sickness, which is a related but different effect
Say anything about dizziness that comes without spinning
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: Dizziness that comes without spinning, or doesn't go away, is a reason to tell an adult.

sources: NIH NIDCD: Balance and the inner ear (student pages)
